title: Cross-Over Study Evaluating the TASKA GEN2 Myoelectric Hand Prosthesis
official: Prospective Multicentre Randomized Cross-Over Study Evaluating Specific Function of Upper-Limb Amputee Patients Using the Multi-Grip Myoelectric Hand Prosthesis GEN2 Versus Other Multi-Grip Myoelectric Hand Prostheses
summary: This prospective multicentre randomized cross-over post-market clinical follow-up study compares the TASKA GEN2 multi-grip myoelectric hand prosthesis with marketed comparator prostheses in adults with upper-limb amputation. The study evaluates specific function using the Patient-Specific Functional Scale together with upper-limb function, comfort, quality of life, satisfaction and safety outcomes.

interventions.name: TASKA GEN2 Multi-Grip Myoelectric Hand Prosthesis
Michelangelo or I-Limb Ultra multi-grip myoelectric prosthesis

criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Adult patient (\>18 years).
* Unilateral acquired or congenital transradial or transhumeral amputation or elbow disarticulation.
* Using Michelangelo or I-Limb Ultra prosthesis for \>2 months.
* Prosthesis use \>6 hours/day.
* Written informed consent.

Exclusion Criteria:

* Bilateral upper-limb amputation.
* Shoulder disarticulation.
* Lower-limb amputation.
* Temporary prosthesis.
* Major expected routine activity change.
* Progressive pathology preventing follow-up.
* Pregnancy.
* Protected/vulnerable adults.
* No health insurance affiliation.
* Unable to understand study instructions.
